name: Summer at BC High
description_short: Summer programs on BC High's Dorchester campus: a coed day camp for ages 5 to 9 with swim lessons and sports, a themed adventure week program for ages 10 to 14, plus boys' sports camps, coding, art and academic courses.
refund_policy_summary: $100 per session deposit is non refundable. Withdraw before June 1, 2027 for a refund of everything else; no refunds after June 1, 2027.

sessions.name: Eagle Summer Quest 1: Adventures in Sports (ages 10 to 14)
Eagle Summer Quest 2: Adventures in Fitness (ages 10 to 14)
Eagle Summer Quest 3: Adventures in Art (ages 10 to 14)
Eagle Summer Quest 4: Adventures in Boston (ages 10 to 14)

notes: Registration for Summer 2027 opens December 7, 2026; $50 early bird discount by January 5, 2027; 10% sibling discount. Eagle Day Camp ages 5 to 9, 9 am to 4 pm (drop off from 8:30), half day option to 1 pm for ages 5 to 7 at $800. Eagle Summer Quest ages 10 to 14, 9 am to 4 pm; week 4 uses BC High vans for daily Boston trips. Sports camps (baseball, basketball, soccer, football) are for boys entering grades 4 to 12, about $375 to $435 a week. Specialty programs (Minecraft, coding and robotics, Roblox, cooking, Day of AI, animation) are coed, grades 4 to 12, about $525 to $600. Academic courses (SAT prep, chemistry, algebra, college essay, credit recovery) also offered. Lunch can be bought in the dining hall (closed Fridays). No extended day for sports or specialty programs. Near the JFK/UMass Red Line stop.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer 2027 page: programs June 14 to August 27, 2027. Eagle Day Camp ages 5 to 9, four 2 week sessions at $1,200 ($800 half day for ages 5 to 7), 9 am to 4 pm; Eagle Summer Quest ages 10 to 14, $600 a week ($850 for week 4); sports, specialty and academic programs for entering grades 4 to 12. age_max 18 derived from grade 12. price_per_week is the Summer Quest weekly rate (the day camp is also $600 a week, sold in 2 week sessions). Lunch costs extra; no transportation

warnings: One listing covers every BC High summer program because they all meet on the same campus; sessions list only the two day camp programs.
